```{python}
from pathlib import Path

from branca.element import Element, MacroElement, Template
import folium
import geopandas as gpd
import h3
```

```{python}
DATA_PATH = Path('data/building_with _inference.geojson')
DAMAGE_FIELD = 'predicted_class'

buildings = gpd.read_file(DATA_PATH)
if buildings.crs is None:
    buildings = buildings.set_crs('EPSG:4326')
buildings = buildings.to_crs('EPSG:4326')

status = buildings[DAMAGE_FIELD].astype('string').str.strip().str.lower()
scored = buildings.loc[status.isin(['damaged', 'undamaged'])].copy()
scored['prediction'] = status.loc[scored.index]
scored['confidence_pct'] = (100 * scored['confidence']).round(1).astype('string') + '%'
scored['prob_damaged_pct'] = (100 * scored['prob_damaged']).round(1).astype('string') + '%'

damaged_count = int(scored['prediction'].eq('damaged').sum())
undamaged_count = int(scored['prediction'].eq('undamaged').sum())
total_count = len(scored)

map_center = (47.6588, -117.4260)

m = folium.Map(
    location=map_center,
    zoom_start=10,
    tiles=None,
    control_scale=True,
    prefer_canvas=True,
)

folium.TileLayer(
    tiles='https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Street_Map/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}',
    attr='Tiles &copy; Esri',
    name='Esri World Street Map',
    control=True,
).add_to(m)

folium.TileLayer(
    tiles='https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}',
    attr='Tiles &copy; Esri',
    name='Esri World Imagery',
    control=True,
    show=False,
).add_to(m)


def h3_cell_feature(cell, resolution, records):
    total = len(records)
    damaged = int(records['prediction'].eq('damaged').sum())
    undamaged = total - damaged
    damage_rate = damaged / total if total else 0
    avg_damage_prob = float(records['prob_damaged'].mean()) if total else 0

    boundary = h3.cell_to_boundary(cell)
    coordinates = [[lng, lat] for lat, lng in boundary]
    coordinates.append(coordinates[0])

    return {
        'type': 'Feature',
        'properties': {
            'h3_cell': cell,
            'resolution': resolution,
            'buildings': total,
            'damaged': damaged,
            'undamaged': undamaged,
            'damage_rate': round(damage_rate, 4),
            'damage_pct': f'{100 * damage_rate:.1f}%',
            'avg_damage_prob': round(avg_damage_prob, 4),
            'avg_damage_prob_pct': f'{100 * avg_damage_prob:.1f}%',
        },
        'geometry': {
            'type': 'Polygon',
            'coordinates': [coordinates],
        },
    }


def h3_geojson(data, resolution):
    h3_data = data[['prediction', 'prob_damaged', 'geometry']].copy()
    points = h3_data.geometry.representative_point()
    h3_data['h3_cell'] = [
        h3.latlng_to_cell(point.y, point.x, resolution)
        for point in points
    ]

    return {
        'type': 'FeatureCollection',
        'features': [
            h3_cell_feature(cell, resolution, records)
            for cell, records in h3_data.groupby('h3_cell')
        ],
    }


def h3_color(damage_rate):
    if damage_rate >= 0.75:
        return '#b2182b'
    if damage_rate >= 0.5:
        return '#ef8a62'
    if damage_rate >= 0.25:
        return '#fddbc7'
    return '#2166ac'


def h3_style(feature):
    damage_rate = feature['properties'].get('damage_rate') or 0
    buildings = feature['properties'].get('buildings') or 0
    return {
        'color': '#4b5563',
        'fillColor': h3_color(damage_rate),
        'fillOpacity': min(0.6, 0.18 + (0.035 * buildings)),
        'opacity': 0.72,
        'weight': 0.9,
    }


def h3_highlight(_feature):
    return {
        'fillOpacity': 0.72,
        'weight': 2.0,
    }


h3_layers = {}
for resolution in [5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10]:
    h3_layer = folium.GeoJson(
        h3_geojson(scored, resolution),
        name=f'H3 damage grid r{resolution}',
        show=False,
        control=False,
        style_function=h3_style,
        highlight_function=h3_highlight,
        tooltip=folium.GeoJsonTooltip(
            fields=[
                'resolution',
                'buildings',
                'damaged',
                'undamaged',
                'damage_pct',
                'avg_damage_prob_pct',
            ],
            aliases=[
                'H3 resolution',
                'Buildings',
                'Damaged',
                'Undamaged',
                'Damaged share',
                'Mean damage probability',
            ],
            sticky=False,
        ),
    )
    h3_layer.add_to(m)
    h3_layers[resolution] = h3_layer.get_name()


def footprint_style(feature):
    prediction = feature['properties'].get('prediction')
    damaged = prediction == 'damaged'
    return {
        'color': '#9e1215' if damaged else '#1f5f8b',
        'fillColor': '#d7191c' if damaged else '#2c7bb6',
        'fillOpacity': 0.34 if damaged else 0.2,
        'opacity': 0.85,
        'weight': 0.8,
    }


def footprint_highlight(_feature):
    return {
        'fillOpacity': 0.58,
        'weight': 1.8,
    }


popup_fields = [
    'prediction',
    'confidence_pct',
    'prob_damaged_pct',
    'image_path',
    'id',
]

footprints_layer = folium.GeoJson(
    scored[
        [
            'id',
            'image_path',
            'prediction',
            'confidence_pct',
            'prob_damaged_pct',
            'geometry',
        ]
    ],
    name='Building footprints',
    show=True,
    style_function=footprint_style,
    highlight_function=footprint_highlight,
    tooltip=folium.GeoJsonTooltip(
        fields=['prediction', 'prob_damaged_pct'],
        aliases=['Prediction', 'Damage probability'],
        sticky=False,
    ),
    popup=folium.GeoJsonPopup(
        fields=popup_fields,
        aliases=[
            'Prediction',
            'Confidence',
            'Damage probability',
            'Image',
            'ID',
        ],
        labels=True,
        max_width=360,
    ),
)
footprints_layer.add_to(m)

h3_control_layer = folium.FeatureGroup(
    name='H3 damage grid',
    show=True,
    control=True,
)
h3_control_layer.add_to(m)

bounds = scored.total_bounds
m.fit_bounds(
    [
        [bounds[1], bounds[0]],
        [bounds[3], bounds[2]],
    ],
    padding=(28, 28),
    max_zoom=14,
)

legend_html = '''
<div class='map-legends'>
  <div class='footprint-legend map-legend'>
    <div><span class='legend-dot damaged'></span>Damaged</div>
    <div><span class='legend-dot undamaged'></span>Undamaged</div>
  </div>
  <div id='h3-legend' class='h3-legend map-legend'>
    <div class='legend-title'>H3 damaged share</div>
    <div><span class='legend-swatch h3-low'></span>0-24%</div>
    <div><span class='legend-swatch h3-some'></span>25-49%</div>
    <div><span class='legend-swatch h3-high'></span>50-74%</div>
    <div><span class='legend-swatch h3-severe'></span>75-100%</div>
  </div>
</div>
'''

m.get_root().html.add_child(Element(legend_html))

folium.LayerControl(collapsed=False).add_to(m)

h3_zoom_layers = [
    (0, 8, 5),
    (9, 10, 6),
    (11, 12, 7),
    (13, 14, 8),
    (15, 16, 9),
    (17, 99, 10),
]
h3_layer_entries = ',\n'.join(
    (
        '{'
        f'minZoom: {min_zoom}, '
        f'maxZoom: {max_zoom}, '
        f'resolution: {resolution}, '
        f'layer: {h3_layers[resolution]}'
        '}'
    )
    for min_zoom, max_zoom, resolution in h3_zoom_layers
)

class H3Autoscale(MacroElement):
    _template = Template(
        '''
        {% macro script(this, kwargs) %}
        (function() {
          var map = {{ this.map_name }};
          var footprintLayer = {{ this.footprint_layer_name }};
          var h3ControlLayer = {{ this.h3_control_layer_name }};
          var h3Legend = document.getElementById('{{ this.h3_legend_id }}');
          var h3Layers = [
            {{ this.h3_layer_entries | safe }}
          ];
          var activeH3Layer = null;
          var h3Enabled = map.hasLayer(h3ControlLayer);

          function layerForZoom(zoom) {
            for (var i = 0; i < h3Layers.length; i++) {
              if (zoom >= h3Layers[i].minZoom) {
                if (zoom <= h3Layers[i].maxZoom) {
                  return h3Layers[i];
                }
              }
            }
            return h3Layers[h3Layers.length - 1];
          }

          function setH3LegendVisible(isVisible) {
            if (!h3Legend) {
              return;
            }
            h3Legend.hidden = !isVisible;
            h3Legend.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !isVisible);
          }

          function removeActiveH3Layer() {
            if (activeH3Layer) {
              if (map.hasLayer(activeH3Layer.layer)) {
                map.removeLayer(activeH3Layer.layer);
              }
            }
            activeH3Layer = null;
            setH3LegendVisible(false);
          }

          function updateH3Layer() {
            if (!h3Enabled) {
              removeActiveH3Layer();
              return;
            }

            var nextH3Layer = layerForZoom(map.getZoom());

            if (activeH3Layer) {
              if (activeH3Layer.layer !== nextH3Layer.layer) {
                if (map.hasLayer(activeH3Layer.layer)) {
                  map.removeLayer(activeH3Layer.layer);
                }
              }
            }

            if (!map.hasLayer(nextH3Layer.layer)) {
              nextH3Layer.layer.addTo(map);
            }

            activeH3Layer = nextH3Layer;
            setH3LegendVisible(true);

            if (map.hasLayer(footprintLayer)) {
              if (footprintLayer.bringToFront) {
                footprintLayer.bringToFront();
              }
            }
          }

          map.on('overlayadd', function(event) {
            if (event.layer === h3ControlLayer) {
              h3Enabled = true;
              updateH3Layer();
            }
          });

          map.on('overlayremove', function(event) {
            if (event.layer === h3ControlLayer) {
              h3Enabled = false;
              removeActiveH3Layer();
            }
          });

          map.on('zoomend', updateH3Layer);
          map.whenReady(updateH3Layer);
        })();
        {% endmacro %}
        '''
    )

    def __init__(
        self,
        map_name,
        footprint_layer_name,
        h3_control_layer_name,
        h3_layer_entries,
        h3_legend_id,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self._name = 'H3Autoscale'
        self.map_name = map_name
        self.footprint_layer_name = footprint_layer_name
        self.h3_control_layer_name = h3_control_layer_name
        self.h3_layer_entries = h3_layer_entries
        self.h3_legend_id = h3_legend_id


m.add_child(
    H3Autoscale(
        map_name=m.get_name(),
        footprint_layer_name=footprints_layer.get_name(),
        h3_control_layer_name=h3_control_layer.get_name(),
        h3_layer_entries=h3_layer_entries,
        h3_legend_id='h3-legend',
    )
)

m
```
